title: Must‑Have MSFS 2024 aircraft this Week! 777‑300 RR, Twin Pioneer & Citation Mustang
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (Feb 28): The Captain Sim 777-300 RR, Cessna Citation Mustang, and Twin Pioneer have arrived! This Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for PC is live now.

Today’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update features highly anticipated new aircraft for PC. From the long-haul Captain Sim Boeing 777-300 RR to the Cessna Citation Mustang business jet and the classic Twin Pioneer, this MSFS PC Update is a massive one for virtual pilots.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 BlackBox Simulation: Twin Pioneer (classic utility aircraft with rugged performance)
🛫 Captain Sim: Boeing 777‑300 RR (long‑haul widebody powered by Rolls‑Royce engines)
🛫 Kwikflight: Striker (light aircraft focused on fun and agility)
🛫 Sim Federation: Cessna Citation Mustang (popular entry‑level business jet)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 2Pilot: 747‑400/F MEGAPACK LIVERIES (large airline variety pack, currently discounted)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑300 RR Livery Pack 16 (additional airline options for the 777)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑300 RR Livery Pack 24 (more global operators for the 777)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑300 RR Livery Pack 4 (expanded 777 fleet visuals)
🎨 4Simmers: easyJet Liveries (perfect for short‑haul European ops)
🎨 2Pilot: NEW COCKPIT A330 BLACK (dark cockpit theme for added immersion)

If you enjoy staying up to date with the MSFS marketplace, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and let me know in the comments which aircraft or livery you’re picking up this week.

Thanks for watching and supporting the channel — it really helps more than you think. ✈️ See you in the skies!
